called by invocation

  • CURIE: gmeow:calledByInvocation
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/calledByInvocation
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/agentic

The model invocation that requested this tool call. Functional: one requesting invocation per call. Optional: a recording harness may not expose the invocation — a ToolCall without one is still auditable provenance.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:ToolCall -> gmeow:ModelInvocation; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:calledByInvocation from gmeow:ToolCall to gmeow:ModelInvocation when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:ToolCall, gmeow:ModelInvocation
